title: Self-rewarding and iterative DPO flywheel
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for iterative RPO preference curation, rubric-judge calibration gating against deterministic verifiers and pre-registered holdout flywheel promotion.
boundaries: RubricJudgeCalibrationGate blocks made-up self-rewarding preference pairs whenever Cohen's kappa, exact agreement or false-positive approval rates violate grid calibration bounds against deterministic verifiers.

IterativeRpoPairCurator enforces positive NLL_chosen regularization, length-ratio bias bounds and 3-key structural deduplication so iterative preference rounds do not collapse chosen log-probabilities or reward verbosity.
PreRegisteredFlywheelPromoter rejects candidate generation rounds upon any holdout SHA-256 mismatch, self-review, sanity retention drop or regression cap breach.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for iterative RPO preference curation, rubric-judge calibration gating against deterministic verifiers and pre-registered holdout flywheel promotion

value.lets_workers: Curate (prompt, chosen_verified, rejected_tombstone) preference pairs using Iterative RPO scoring (DPO logistic loss plus per-token NLL_chosen regularization to prevent chosen log-probability collapse), filter length-ratio verbosity bias and 3-key structural duplicates, gate made-up self-rewarding rubric pairs against deterministic verifiers via Cohen's kappa and false-positive caps, and evaluate generation rounds against pre-registered holdout SHA-256 locks.

flow.when: Measure candidate self-rewarding rubric judge agreement (Cohen's kappa, exact agreement and false-positive approval rate) against deterministic verifiers before admitting made-up pairs.
Score verified and calibrated preference pairs with Iterative RPO (DPO margin + alpha * NLL_chosen), filter length-ratio bias and deduplicate across three structural keys.
Independently verify holdout SHA-256 locks, sanity retention bounds, regression caps, distinct reviewer identity and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.

value.worked_example: Made-up rubric calibration, Iterative RPO pair curation and holdout promotion bundle recomputed in test_iterative_rpo_flywheel.py: approves calibrated judge (kappa 0.75, FPR 0.0) while blocking 100% of pairs from uncalibrated judge (kappa -0.2), rejects 1 length-biased pair, 1 chosen-logp-collapse trap and 1 3-key structural duplicate, curates 2 clean pairs (mean DPO margin 0.925, mean RPO loss 0.743994), and verifies SHA-256 holdout lock with +0.20 net gain and 0.0 regression rate.

nouns.title: Guardrail: made-up self-rewarding preference pairs are blocked unless rubric judges pass deterministic verifier calibration
nouns.category_reason: Prevents self-reinforcing reward hacking and false-positive drift across iterative preference rounds.

value.rule: Admit made-up rubric-judged preference pairs only when the rubric judge achieves cohens_kappa >= min_cohens_kappa, exact_agreement >= min_exact_agreement and false_positive_approval_rate <= max_false_positive_rate on deterministic ground-truth verifier checks.
value.how_it_is_checked: RubricJudgeCalibrationGate.gate_made_up_pairs returns zero admitted made-up pairs whenever any calibration threshold fails.

nouns.title: Guardrail: flywheel promotion requires exact holdout SHA-256 match, distinct reviewer and zero inline magic scalars
nouns.category_reason: Prevents holdout tampering, self-approval and hardcoded heuristic drift.

value.rule: Reject generation promotion if holdout SHA-256 differs from preregistered_holdout_sha256, proposer_id == reviewer_id, regression_rate > max_regression_rate or any operational module fails ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.
value.how_it_is_checked: PreRegisteredFlywheelPromoter.evaluate_round and scan_directory_for_hardcoded_values run deterministically during make check.
